name: lavendly
description: Lavendly agent toolkit: six skills (film direction, narrated shorts, consistent multi-shot sequences, budget guardrails, the quality loop, publishing) and the Lavendly MCP connection, sign in on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Make short AI videos with Lavendly from Codex, checked and on budget
interface.longDescription: The Lavendly Agent Toolkit gives Codex the Lavendly MCP (sign in on first use) and six skills that operate it: direct a 15 to 90 s video with a locked hero and a shot plan, make a narrated short or a consistent multi-shot sequence, keep spend inside a budget, check every scene, cut and the whole video before rendering, and publish only after an explicit yes.
defaultPrompt: Direct a 20 second ad for my lamp, same lamp in every shot
Make a 5 second narrated clip of a lighthouse keeper at dawn
Three shots of the same character crossing a market, a bridge, and a station
Check the quality of my last workflow and render it
